'''Jay-Nine''', '''J-9''' or '''Jay''' as he was more commonly known, was a support [[Droid/Legends|droid]] assigned to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Treasury Audit Division]]. He had a domed head and was built with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] instead of legs.<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
